headlines.title_en: US Homebuilder Confidence Edges Up Slightly; Cost Pressures Constrain Sector Recovery
headlines.summary_en: The US National Association of Home Builders (NAHB) and Wells Fargo housing market index showed the August NAHB housing market index at 35 (expected 33, prior 34), with high construction and borrowing costs continuing to constrain the housing market; a reading below 50 indicates more builders view conditions as poor than good, and the index has remained below this level since May 2024. Builders have been trying to attract potential buyers with sales incentives, with 63% reporting the use of incentives and 35% reporting price cuts.

headlines.title_en: Unisplendour: Plans Private Placement to Raise Up to 5.41B Yuan for 6.98% Stake in H3C
headlines.summary_en: Unisplendour Corporation announced that its board of directors convened on August 17, 2026, and approved a proposal to adjust its plan for issuing A-shares to specific targets in 2026. After the adjustment, total funds raised will not exceed RMB 5.41 billion (including this amount), intended for use after deducting issuance costs: acquiring 6.98% equity in H3C (planned RMB 3.39 billion), R&D equipment procurement (planned RMB 400 million), and repaying bank loans (planned RMB 1.62 billion). This adjustment does not constitute a major change to the issuance plan and still requires review by the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and approval from the CSRC.

headlines.summary: 欧洲央行经济学家警告，市场对人工智能的追捧将科技股估值推升至互联网泡沫时期水平，股市估值或将迎来回调。与21世纪初不同，倘若市场出现大幅下跌，政策制定者降息或实施财政刺激的操作空间已十分有限。欧洲央行表示，由于欧洲投资于美国 “七大科技巨头”，且欧洲本土股票估值处于高位，欧洲面临的风险尤为突出。

headlines.title_en: ECB Warns AI Rally Could End in a Correction
headlines.summary_en: European Central Bank economists warned that market enthusiasm for artificial intelligence has pushed tech valuations to levels seen during the internet bubble, potentially leading to a stock market correction. Unlike the early 21st century, if markets were to fall sharply, policymakers would have limited room to cut rates or implement fiscal stimulus. The ECB noted Europe faces particularly prominent risks due to investment in the US 'Magnificent Seven' tech giants and high valuations in European domestic stocks.

headlines.title: 机构：预计加拿大央行将继续保持观望态度
headlines.summary: 加拿大帝国商业银行资本市场经济学家安德鲁·格兰瑟姆表示，加拿大央行不会急于根据7月CPI报告重新考虑利率政策。总体通胀率加速至3.0%，略高于预期，能源价格和世界杯驱动的旅行成本是推高通胀的主要原因。剔除波动性较大的项目后的核心通胀率保持相对温和，接近2%，剔除汽油价格后的通胀率则维持在2.2%不变。格兰瑟姆表示，加拿大央行有充足的时间评估能源价格和美加贸易紧张局势的影响，然后再决定何时调整利率政策。该央行将于9月2日公布下一次利率决议。

headlines.title_en: Institution: Expected Bank of Canada to Maintain its Wait-and-See Stance
headlines.summary_en: Andrew Grantham, economist at CIBC Capital Markets, said the Bank of Canada will not rush to reconsider monetary policy based on July's CPI report. Overall inflation accelerated to 3.0%, slightly above expectations, driven mainly by energy prices and World Cup-related travel costs. Core inflation excluding volatile items remained relatively moderate near 2%, while inflation excluding gasoline held steady at 2.2%. Grantham said the Bank of Canada has ample time to assess the impact of energy prices and US-Canada trade tensions before deciding when to adjust rates. The central bank will announce its next rate decision on September 2.

headlines.title: 韩国前总理金民锡当选执政党共同民主党党首
headlines.summary: 韩国执政党共同民主党17日在大田市举行全国党员大会，前国务总理金民锡当选新一任党首。共同民主党党首任期两年。金民锡将掌握2028年韩国国会议员选举共同民主党候选人提名权，对李在明政府执政及执政党内部权力格局具有重要影响，其影响力还可能延续至下一届韩国总统选举前的执政阵营力量重组。韩联社报道称，在总统李在明支持率不断下滑之际，金民锡肩负重任，承担着增强党政协作施政、弥合全党分歧的关键任务。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Former South Korean Prime Minister Kim Min-seok Elected Leader of Ruling Democratic Party
headlines.summary_en: South Korea's ruling Democratic Party held a national party convention in Daejeon on the 17th, with former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok elected as the new party leader. The Democratic Party leader serves a two-year term. Kim Min-seok will control candidate nominations for the 2028 National Assembly elections, significantly impacting the Lee Jae-myung administration's governance and internal party power dynamics, with influence potentially extending to reshuffling the ruling camp ahead of the next presidential election. Yonhap reported that amid President Lee Jae-myung's declining approval ratings, Kim Min-seok shoulders the key tasks of enhancing party-government coordination and bridging party divisions. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 千问办公开源MyContext
headlines.summary: 近日，千问办公开源了个人工作上下文基础设施MyContext，项目上线一周多，在GitHub上已收获超1k星，这也是千问办公的首个开源项目。MyContext可以把海量异构的个人工作数据加工成Agent易理解的专属工作档案，让Agent真正读懂用户和真实业务工作流，并最终在决策和执行等环节实现人机协同，提升Agent在工作场景下的表现。（科创板日报）

headlines.title_en: Qwen Office open-sources MyContext
headlines.summary_en: Recently, Qianwen Office open-sourced its personal work context infrastructure MyContext. The project has gained over 1k stars on GitHub in just over a week since launch, making it Qianwen Office's first open-source project. MyContext can process vast heterogeneous personal work data into agent-friendly personalized work profiles, enabling agents to truly understand users and real business workflows, ultimately achieving human-machine collaboration in decision-making and execution, improving agent performance in work scenarios. (STAR Market Daily)

headlines.title_en: Canada's Inflation Rate Rises to 3%; Middle East Conflict Continues to Push Up Gasoline Prices
headlines.summary_en: As Middle East conflicts continue to push up gasoline prices, Canada's inflation rate edged up to 3%, but core price indicators remained moderate. Statistics Canada reported Monday that gasoline prices rose 25.7% year-on-year in July, up from June's 20.5%. Excluding gasoline, the consumer price index (CPI) rose 2.2% for a third consecutive month. CPI rose 0.5% month-on-month. Economists had expected overall inflation to edge up to 2.9% from June's 2.8%. Despite slightly higher-than-expected overall inflation, the latest data suggests inflationary pressures remain contained, with limited signs of energy cost pass-through to the broader economy. The Bank of Canada's preferred inflation metric averaged 1.95%, up slightly from the prior month and still below the 2% target.
